crossRefs.note: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh…
They said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was…
A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…

people.name: Zelophehad
people.line: Israelite whose daughters received his inheritance

translations.web: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
translations.bsb: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly. You certainly must give them property as an inheritance among their father’s brothers and transfer their father’s inheritance to them.
translations.kjv: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass
translations.asv: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
